title: Urban Legacy Reclaimed Barnwood Planks | Floating Shelves for Wall w/Flush Mount Shelf Bracket Set Included | Set of 2 (Coffee Bean, 18"x 4.5"x 2")

reviews.title: Great quality - exceptionally beautiful.
reviews.body: Was skeptical because I saw a few review photos that did NOT look like the product photos. My experience was wonderful, these are exactly like the product photos IMO. I purchased four of the 30” pieces and am so happy. There is noticeable color variation between boards, but I felt it was complimentary and gives the look and feel I was after, a natural weathered look. The distressing is not uniform (in a good way) and appears very authentic and not mechanically distressed in production. These hang very straight and flat, and installation was not too difficult. I did them on my own and felt it was doable.My only critique is that they could stand to be reinforced with L brackets underneath if you are worried about kids being around them, but in low traffic areas where there’s are out of reach, the supplied hardware is plenty strong. Also, one of my four boards was not consistent with bracket placement.. which didn’t matter to me, since I didn’t use the enclosed template guide anyhow.Overall highly recommend, this is a very well made product and looks stunning in person.

reviews.title: Awesome product.
reviews.body: These are awesome! The hardware is spot on. The installation was easy after reading the instructions. The quality is good too. Just the right dimensions for our living room walls. It holds all that we want it to hold. Nothing too heavy, just photos and cameras. All the hardware was included and the right size. Great dark rich color.Be mindful of your walls if they are a lighter color, when you move them into position on the wall clips your walls can get marked up. Maybe painters' tape could help with that?

reviews.title: true reclaimed wood. GORGEOUS
reviews.body: The real deal. Amazing!! It may feel like you're paying too much for a small amount of wood but this stuff looks SO good...you're paying for history. The templates for hanging were spot on and my two shelves were perfectly level. They are thick, heavy, legit and........I just don't know how to say this a real reclaimed item and not some cheap knockoff like so many other listings.  I love my shelves, and have ordered more from the company. Stellar.

reviews.title: Horrible Quality for price paid
reviews.body: I ordered the wrong size (my fault). I received a full refund but had to pay $54 & change to ship them back. I should have just kept them & give away as a gift. Been searching for 30” x 7” & can’t find anywhere except this place. So I ordered the coffee bean (again). My husband had to use some muscle power to hammer them in place. Well they look nice from far away but if you’re within 4 ft they look terrible. I know they say it’s “reclaimed wood” but the bottom shelf looks looks warped (uneven), they’re rough & splintered & have several visible holes in the front. I’ve asked my husband to switch the bottom to the top so maybe won’t notice how uneven it is but if/when he does, he says it’s going to scratch up the paint on the wall. 😒 I am still looking for some nicer quality ones & will move these to the garage or outside patio for plants eventually.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on September 16, 2022

features: GENUINE RECLAIMED WOOD SHELVES: These rustic wood shelves were hand made from reclaimed barn wood. The reclaimed barn wood features knots, saw marks and imperfections that tell a story of time and use. We have partnered with several local Amish artisans from Lancaster County, PA to help transform these weathered wood shelves in stunning reclaimed wood floating shelves.

MINIMALIST DESIGN AND RUSTIC ELEGANCE: Minimalist and rustic design come together in these rustic floating shelves. Built from reclaimed barn planks, they carry the nuances of rural living into your space. Our reclaimed wood shelf options include Natural wood floating shelves with no finish. We also offer a Coffee Bean stain for a darker look, or a White Wash finish that makes a beautiful white floating shelf.

VARIETY OF SIZES: Our rustic wood shelves range in size from an 18 inch floating shelf to a 48 inch floating shelf. Each of the reclaimed wood planks for shelves range in thickness from 1 5/8" to 2", depending on where the plank was used in the original barn. The reclaimed barn wood floating shelves are available in 4.5" and 7" depths.

MULTI-PURPOSE FARMHOUSE SHELVES AND RECLAIMED BARNWOOD PLANKS FOR WALLS: Display photos, artwork, plants an dmore on the versatile reclaimed barn wood planks made into natural wood floating shelves. Our reclaimed wood wall planks make gorgeous wall shelves for living rooms, kitchen floating shelves, or a simple dining room shelf. They are also useful as floating shelves for bedrooms, fulfilling your need for wall mounted shelves or a wood shelf for walls of any room!

EASY TO INSTALL WEATHERED BARNWOOD FLOATING SHELVES: Urban Legacy shelves are large floating shelves for walls that come with everyhting you need to mount them easily. You'll find 2 notches on the back of the wooden shelves for wall brackets to attach to the brackets on the shelf. This allows each barnwood shelf to sit flush against your wall for a true floating shelf.
